title: The FotMob TOTW for the Premier League: Matchday 7’s Best XI featuring Haaland, Neto, and Wirtz
subtitle: FotMob
paragraphs: NewsAboutTV schedulesThe FotMob TOTW for the Premier League: Matchday 7’s Best XI featuring Haaland, Neto, and WirtzShareMatchday 7 of the Premier League is in the books and Manchester City maintained their 100% record thanks to a 3-2 win over Ipswich.
Arsenal remain hot on their heels thanks to a win over Nottingham Forest, while Sunderland prop up the table following another damaging defeat.
Aston Villa goalkeeper Zion Suzuki kept his second clean sheet in the space of four days – and third overall this season – in the victory against Newcastle.

The Japanese international may have made only one save during the game, but he also succeeded with 100% of his total duels contested and took 65 touches, indicating how comfortable he was with the ball at his feet.
Castagne was impressive in Fulham’s 1-0 win over Hull and he deserves his spot at right-back in the Team of the Week (TOTW).
The defender had the most touches out of anyone on the pitch (123), completed the most dribbles (4) and covered the most distance (12.4km) throughout the game.
His performance contributed to a second clean sheet of the season for the Cottagers.
Bournemouth sealed their first league win under Marco Rose and James Hill played a massive part in that.
The defender made nine defensive contributions during the game, including seven clearances, and two tackles.
He demonstrated his strength in one-on-one battles, winning 100% of his ground duels and 88% of his aerial duels contested during the game, as he makes the TOTW for the first time this term.
Luka Vušković could turn out to be one of the signings of the season for Brighton. The defender took the most touches of anyone (103) as he aimed to build attacks from the back.
Indeed, he made six passes into the final third, created one chance and registered three shots. Not bad going for a centre-back.
Defensively, Vuskovic recorded three interceptions, seven clearances and six recoveries, and we expect him to remain a familiar face in our TOTW going forward this season.

Vušković is joined in the team by Olivier Boscagli, as the French defender notched his first assist of the season during the 5-0 thrashing of rivals Crystal Palace at the weekend in what was a standout showing at left-back.
He created three chances, made 14 passes into the final third and registered six defensive contributions in total as Brighton made it five wins from seven league games this season.
His 8.3 match rating was the best across the back four in the TOTW for matchday seven.

Chelsea sealed a solid win over Everton as Pedro Neto netted both goals during the game. Surprisingly, this was the first time he had scored a brace in a Premier League match and it couldn’t have come at a better time.
The winger was a livewire throughout the game, recording the most touches (5) in the opposition box than anyone else, while also creating the most chances (5) in the 90 minutes.

Not just content with being a nuisance in the final third, Neto even recorded nine defensive contributions, which included five recoveries, to help his side when they didn’t have the ball. As such, Neto is the star man this week with a match rating of 9.3.
Much has been said about Florian Wirtz’s performances for Liverpool, but he was impressive in the win over Brentford.
